RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel in civil service recruitment raises valid concerns about unconscious bias and may violate public sector guidelines requiring diverse interview panels. However, raising it immediately without evidence could be counterproductive.

First, follow up on your overdue written feedback. Check your ministry’s hiring regulations to see if gender-balanced panels are mandatory; a procedural violation is an objective basis for inquiry. 

While the selected candidate also possesses strong qualifications, research shows single-gender panels increase the risk of affinity bias. If the feedback is vague, inconsistent with the job criteria, or reveals procedural non-compliance, you should raise the panel composition through internal grievance or HR channels.
